name: @sparq/bullmq-groups
description: POC: per-group FIFO with round-robin fairness between groups, on top of open-source BullMQ

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && mkdir -p dist/lua && cp src/lua/*.lua dist/lua/
scripts.redis:up: docker run -d --rm --name bullmq-groups-redis -p 127.0.0.1:6390:6379 redis:7-alpine redis-server --save '' --appendonly no
